trap.trapplacer.front_door.desc: A little hut with an iron double door. The carpet just inside the door is fake: it drops you 15 blocks onto stalagmites.
trap.trapplacer.front_door.trigger: stepping on a pressure plate and walking in
trap.trapplacer.loot_chest.desc: A double chest on a mossy patch. Open it and the ground in front of it disappears.
trap.trapplacer.crafting_table.desc: A little crafting camp. Steal the table or light the furnace and fall into a stalagmite pit. Put a crafting table back to close it again.
trap.trapplacer.crafting_table.trigger: breaking the crafting table or smelting in the furnace
trap.trapplacer.bed.desc: A cozy cabin. Sleeping in the bed lights 12 TNT hidden under the floor.
trap.trapplacer.diamond_mine.desc: A rocky outcrop with a mine tunnel and a diamond at the end. Mining it slams the tunnel shut and pours lava from the ceiling.
trap.trapplacer.powder_snow.desc: Looks like snow, isn't. Anyone without leather boots sinks through and falls 13 blocks onto stalagmites.
trap.trapplacer.arrow_railgun.desc: ProfessorTNT-style railgun: 27 TNT launch one arrow fast enough to one-shot most players. Comes loaded with 4 shots.
trap.trapplacer.arrow_railgun.trigger: pressing the button on the post at the back (it fires about 4 seconds later)
trap.trapplacer.orbital_arrow_cannon.des: FireBall11901's Donut SMP orbital arrow cannon, pasted exactly as saved, with its 194 arrows of ammo already loaded.
trap.trapplacer.orbital_arrow_cannon.tri: its own controls (note blocks and tripwire at the base)
trap.trapplacer.duck_railgun.desc: Duckism7's instant wind-charge railgun, pasted exactly as saved, with its wind charges loaded.
trap.trapplacer.popup_arrow_cannon.desc: antoberak's pop-up arrow cannon/railgun, pasted exactly as saved, with its dispensers loaded.
trap.trapplacer.popup_arrow_cannon.trigg: the button on its right side
trap.trapplacer.flat_ground.desc: zm3s's flat ground trap, pasted exactly as saved and dug into the ground, so only a patch of grass and a pressure plate show.
tooltip.trapplacer.controls: Right-click: place  |  Sneak + right-click: next trap
message.trapplacer.busy: Wait for your last trap to finish building
message.trapplacer.height: Not enough room above or below for this trap here
message.trapplacer.unloaded: Part of that area isn't loaded
message.trapplacer.no_target: Look at the ground where the trap should go
message.trapplacer.preview: %s - right-click to place, sneak + right-click to switch
command.trapplacer.bad_facing: Facing must be north, east, south or west (got %s)
command.trapplacer.give: Gave a Trap Placer to %s player(s)
